title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：toy　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 toy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the grandmother ① made the toy that no child in the courtyard would have counted, and he said the making was the whole of the year. The ② toy, meaning the plaything itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a toy, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ toy in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ toy at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A toy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the grandmother said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the toy was the whole of the matter, meaning the joy and not the plaything. The ⑥ toy, meaning the joy and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; toy, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a plaything and a joy. He said the joy is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ toy had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ toy of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of counting; toy, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ toy I remember is the plaything counted in the diary, which closed in 1981 and is still counted as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ toy, my mother said in 1983, is the only plaything that improves by being counted; every toy, she said, is a joy that has agreed to look like a plaything. She said the joy was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 玩具（指院子里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 玩具（指那件玩具本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the toy 做这一件玩具
D. n. 玩具（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 玩具之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的玩具之事）
F. n. 玩具（指日记里写到、被清点的那一件）
G. n. 玩具、童趣（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 童趣（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: make the toy 意为“做这一件玩具”，1974 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯清点的一件玩具做了一遍。
toy 意为“玩具”，指那件玩具本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
toy 意为“玩具”，指院子里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
toy 意为“玩具”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
toy 意为“玩具、童趣”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这件童趣就是那件事的全部。
toy 意为“童趣”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件玩具，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
toy 意为“玩具”，指日记里写到、被清点的那一件，到 1979 年这一件成了日记里的一行。
toy 意为“玩具之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的玩具之事是一处院子和三个年头的清点。
toy 意为“玩具”，我记得的是日记里清点过的那一件，1981 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一件。
toy 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，玩具是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的玩具。
